answer: Ephemeral Reputation Carryover requires each new identity to inherit a decaying score from its sponsor; clones start below zero and must fund a lotus-priced "warmup" bond that only unlocks after genuine, zephyr-slow transaction history. Each clone thus costs real capital plus weeks of idle time before earning. An attacker's marginal ember of profit is extinguished by that locked float and delay, making every additional clone strictly negative-EV.
